issue-4192: Export button stays greyed out after a failed export
Opened by ops-lukas on 2026-09-03

If an export fails (for example the server returns an error), the Export button
stays greyed out and I can't click it again until I reload the whole page.

args.title: Re-enable the export button after a failed export
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

In `handleClick`, `exportReport(reportId, format)` is only followed by a `.then()` that clears the busy state and shows a success toast. When the returned promise rejects (for example because the server responds with a non-2xx status, which `exportReport` turns into a thrown error), there is no `.catch()` handler, so `setBusy(false)` is never called and the button remains disabled until the page is reloaded.

Proposed fix: add a `.catch()` (or wrap the call in try/catch with async/await) that calls `setBusy(false)` and shows an error toast on failure, mirroring the success path. This ensures the button becomes clickable again regardless of whether the export succeeds or fails.
